requirements.quote:
enum {
          client_hello(1),
          server_hello(2),
          new_session_ticket(4),
          end_of_early_data(5),
          encrypted_extensions(8),
          certificate(11),
          certificate_request(13),
          certificate_verify(15),
          finished(20),
          key_update(24),
          message_hash(254),
          (255)
      } HandshakeType;
requirements.condition: when encoding or interpreting a HandshakeType
requirements.required_behavior: use the declared numeric assignments: client_hello 1, server_hello 2, new_session_ticket 4, end_of_early_data 5, encrypted_extensions 8, certificate 11, certificate_request 13, certificate_verify 15, finished 20, key_update 24, and message_hash 254
requirements.forbidden_behavior: assign a different numeric value to a declared HandshakeType
requirements.why_checkable: The encoder and decoder's HandshakeType lookup table can be compared with the declared assignments.

requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing a Handshake message
requirements.required_behavior: encode and interpret the first message field as a HandshakeType named msg_type
requirements.why_checkable: The handshake header field type and position are directly inspectable.

requirements.quote: uint24 length;             /* remaining bytes in message */
requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing a Handshake message
requirements.required_behavior: encode length as a uint24 equal to the number of remaining bytes in the message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a length value that does not delimit exactly the remaining message bytes
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can compare the 24-bit header length with the actual encoded payload size.

requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing the body of a Handshake message
requirements.required_behavior: select the body structure from msg_type using the declared ClientHello, ServerHello, EndOfEarlyData, EncryptedExtensions, CertificateRequest, Certificate, CertificateVerify, Finished, NewSessionTicket, and KeyUpdate mappings
requirements.forbidden_behavior: interpret a declared handshake message type using a different body structure
requirements.why_checkable: Each declared message type has a concrete payload-dispatch mapping in the handshake codec.

requirements.quote:
Protocol messages MUST be sent in the order defined in Section 4.4.1
   and shown in the diagrams in Section 2.
requirements.required_behavior: send protocol messages only in the handshake order defined by Section 4.4.1 and the Section 2 diagrams
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a protocol message out of the defined handshake order
requirements.why_checkable: The handshake state machine's permitted outbound transitions can be compared with the defined message sequence.

requirements.quote:
A peer which receives a
   handshake message in an unexpected order MUST abort the handshake
   with an "unexpected_message" alert.
requirements.condition: a peer receives a handshake message in an unexpected order
requirements.why_checkable: An out-of-order message can be injected and the resulting alert and termination observed.
